Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. Our security team at AcmeHealth is starting the CAIQ mapping exercise and Veridian (our assessor) has a few targeted asks before they can finalize a draft:

1) A control linkage spreadsheet that maps Redwood controls to the CSA control IDs (we need the mapping and a short rationale per control).
2) A 7-day ephemeral log pull for the inference runtime (token-level telemetry redacted) to validate retention and replay controls.
3) A short workshop with the control owners to walk through the spreadsheet and call out any compensating controls.

Can you confirm who owns control mapping on your side, and whether you can provide the log pull by EOD Thursday? If not, please propose a timetable.

Thanks — and please loop in whoever will own the artifact handoff.

Thanks for the quick reply — appreciate the template. A couple of clarifying items from the assessor side before we accept the spreadsheet as complete:

- For controls that reference runtime telemetry (e.g., CSA CCM infra controls INFR-6 / LOG-1 style), we need the exact query used to extract the set and a short note on any sampling or filtering applied.
- For the log pull, we need the export to include time-synced syslog timestamps and the timezone used; if you redacted token payloads, please note the redaction method (hash vs replace) in the metadata.

We prefer delivery to a secure S3 presigned URL (we will provide credentials) but can accept a shared Drive link if you have DLP blocking S3 uploads.

One more ask: can you include a short change-history sheet in the spreadsheet (who added what and when) — Veridian uses that to validate owner attestations.

Best,
Aaron Park
Senior Assessor, Veridian Security

Hi Aaron / Lisa / team —

Quick status update from infra:

- Export mechanics: We will run the telemetry export from the runtime observability cluster (region: us-west-2). The extract will use the following steps: generate a time-bounded query, redact token payloads by replacing token text with deterministic SHA256 hashes (salted per-export), preserve trace IDs and timestamps, and output JSON lines compressed with gzip.
- Timestamps: all events will be exported with ISO8601 UTC timestamps; we will include an export metadata.json describing the query and filters.
- Delivery: we can push the bundle to a pre-signed S3 URL. Please confirm when you share upload credentials.
- Timeline: I will run the extraction Thursday morning (05/14) and expect the upload to complete by EOD Thursday (2026-05-14).

I attached the extraction instructions stub (ephemeral_log_pull_instructions.txt) to this thread.

Jordan Blake
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
